locked_rules.era_and_language: Compiled in the early 2010s (Almeida et al., ACM DocEng 2011); English SMS messages only.
locked_rules.uci_repository_license: CC BY 4.0 (UCI Machine Learning Repository, Dataset ID 228)
locked_rules.deduplication_policy: Drop whitespace-collapsed lowercase duplicates (keeping first stripped text) before splitting; assert zero exact or normalized text overlap across train/val/test.
locked_rules.threshold_selection_rule: Maximize validation F1 on the spam class using the validation split only.
models: Hugging Face Zero-Shot NLI Classifier (Step 5 baseline)
Fine-tuned DistilBERT (Step 6: 3 seeds, 2-3 epochs, report mean +/- sample std with ddof=1)
locked_rules.test_hygiene_rule: No hyperparameter tuning or threshold adjustment after viewing UCI test set or modern test set numbers.
locked_rules.modern_test_set_rule: Generic modern scam/normal messages (no real numbers or links), evaluated once at the end, never used for training.

duplicate_audit.dedup_method_applied: drop_duplicates(subset=['sms_norm'], keep='first') preserving original sms_stripped text

modern_test_set.usage_constraint: Held out strictly for single-use final evaluation at Step 7; never used for training or threshold selection.
